item.title: Indian Law Partners (ILP) advises BlueScope Steel Australia on its exit from Tata BlueScope Steel
item.description: Indian Law Partners advised BlueScope Steel Australia on its exit from the Tata BlueScope Steel joint venture through the sale of its entire 50% stake to Tata Steel for ₹1,100 crore. The post Indian Law Partners (ILP) advises BlueScope Steel Australia on its exit from Tata BlueScope Steel appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Jharkhand High Court: Concealment of age and murder conviction before marriage amounts to mental cruelty, destroys trust
item.description: “The conduct of the wife by concealing the material fact about her age and her conviction of life in a murder case, before contracting marriage, has caused mental agony to the husband to such an extent that it is almost impossible for them to live together.” The post Jharkhand High Court: Concealment of age and murder conviction before marriage amounts to mental cruelty, destroys trust appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay HC imposes Rs 50,000 costs on litigant for unverified AI- Generated Submissions
item.description: “If an AI tool is used in aid of research, it is welcome; however, there is great responsibility upon the party, even an advocate using such tools, to cross verify the references and make sure that the material generated by the computer is really relevant, genuine and in existence.” The post Bombay HC imposes Rs 50,000 costs on litigant for unverified AI- Generated Submissions appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court protects Aaj Tak logo from trade mark infringement
item.description: The plaintiffs submitted that they had been using their distinctive logo with the word AAJ TAK written in hindi in white color against a red background with a black outline since 1995 and it had acquired a secondary meaning. The post Delhi High Court protects Aaj Tak logo from trade mark infringement appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Mere reinstatement does not preclude conducting departmental enquiry over past misconduct: Rajasthan High Court dismisses Health Officer’s plea challenging penalty order
